analytics.trackersSaveFailed: Sona could not save the trackers. Try again.

notes.title: My notes
notes.liveDescription: Type as roughly as you like. These notes stay on this Mac and steer the notes Sona generates when the meeting ends.
notes.placeholder: Anything worth remembering: names, numbers, what to follow up on
notes.conflict: These notes changed somewhere else. Reopen the meeting to load the current version.
notes.enhanceFailed: Sona could not rebuild the notes. Open the meeting again and retry.
notes.catchUpNoTranscript: Nothing to recap yet. Sona transcribes after you stop recording, so a recap is available once the transcript starts arriving.
notes.catchUpUnavailable: The on-device model is unavailable, so no recap was written.
notes.catchUpFailed: Sona could not build a recap. Try again.

prompt.body: Sona can take local notes for this call.

calendar.label: Use my calendar
calendar.description: Shows a countdown a minute before events with two or more attendees. macOS asks for full calendar access the first time, because Apple offers no read-only grant.

autoStart.label: Open the meeting when its countdown is showing

apps.label: Meeting apps
apps.description: One bundle identifier per line. An entry only counts while that app is running, so a renamed identifier is inert rather than wrong.
apps.noneRunning: None of these are running right now.

state.title: What detection can see
state.calendarDenied: Calendar access was not granted, so only the microphone path runs.
state.notificationsDenied: Notifications are off for Sona, so prompts appear in the app only.
state.bluetoothCaveat: A meeting app is open but nothing reports using the microphone. Bluetooth headsets often do not, so start the meeting yourself if one is running.
state.noSilenceStop: Captures stop on the event end, the app quitting, sleep, or your own stop. The silence timer needs live transcription, which runs after a meeting ends.

why.sonaHoldsMic: Sona is using the microphone, so nothing else can be identified right now.
why.captureActive: A meeting is already being captured.
why.noSignal: Nothing is using the microphone yet.
why.soloEvent: The next event has fewer than two attendees, so it reads as blocked time.
why.unknownApp: Something is using the microphone, but it is not a known meeting app.
why.browserUnreadable: A browser is in front, but its tab title cannot be read.
why.browserNotMeeting: A browser is in front and its tab is not a call.

notify.inApp: Shown in Sona only: notifications are off
notify.autoOpen: Open this meeting when it starts

preview.linkFailed: Sona could not open that link.
preview.skippedNote: Skipping hides an offer here. Sona keeps seeing the call until the offer expires.

agentPanel.empty: Ask about Sona settings. Proposals appear here for review before anything changes.

hero.gestureTapHold: tap to toggle · hold to talk

update.available: Sona {{latest}} is available. This install is on {{current}}.

recovery.title: Recover a sync account
recovery.oneTime: Sona shows this code once and does not store it.
